title: "Context.init() must only be called once" in rclpy and "context is already initialized" in rclcpp: double init, tests, notebooks and with rclpy.init(), measured
excerpt: A second rclpy.init() or rclcpp::init() fails, but the first context keeps working. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: re-init after shutdown works, an ok() guard or teardown shutdown fixes tests, and with rclpy.init() only works on Lyrical.
